source:
@@U01951@@
We'll go from fire to fire, I'll play pimp to your lover.

@@U01953@@
Gentlemen, not so fast! Slow down! Pass by and you miss the opportunity! Here, take a look, do, inspect my merchandise. Quite a variety, wouldn't you say? And yet there’s nothing in my little stall— nothing like it in the whole wide world— that hasn't done malicious harm, sometime, somewhere, to mankind and to the world at large. You'll find here no dagger that hasn’t dripped blood, no goblet that hasn’t poured destructive hot poison into a sturdy, healthy body, no jewel that hasn't seduced some lovely girl, no sword that hasn't severed some pact or with guile stabbed an enemy in the back.

@@U01955@@
Old Auntie, I'd say you're behind the times. What done is done, what's past is past. Deal in novelties. Only novelties appeal today.

@@U01957@@
I could lose myself if 1 don’t take care! This is a marvelous fair, I must say!

@@U01959@@
This whirlpool of a mob is struggling to get to the top. You think you're shoving when you're being shoved.
translation:
@@U01951@@
我们会从火到火，我会为你的爱人扮演皮条客。

@@U01953@@
先生们，别那么快！减速！错过了就错过机会了！在这里，看一看、检查一下我的商品。种类繁多，你说呢？然而，在我的小摊子里——全世界没有一样东西——在某个时间、某个地方，对人类和整个世界造成了恶意伤害。在这里你会发现，没有一把匕首不曾滴过鲜血，没有一把高脚杯不曾将毁灭性的热毒倒入坚固、健康的身体里，没有一件珠宝不曾勾引过可爱的女孩，没有一把剑不曾撕破过某种契约，或者用诡计从背后刺伤过敌人。

@@U01955@@
老阿姨，我想说你落后于时代了。做过的事就做了，过去的就过去了。经营新奇事物。今天只有新奇的东西才有吸引力。

@@U01957@@
如果我不小心，我可能会迷失自我！我必须说，这是一个了不起的展会！

@@U01959@@
这个暴徒的漩涡正在努力到达顶端。当你被推挤时，你认为自己在推挤。
